Adapted for WurstB+ Plus v1.5.1 on 2026-11-07.
Copyright (c) Meteor Development. Slippy, EndermanLook, BuildHeight -> native modules; SoundBlocker -> SoundModifier; AntiHunger -> AntiHunger; NoStatusEffects -> configurable NoLevitation; BreakDelay -> FastBreak; AutoRespawn death record -> native waypoint manager. Native Wurst events/settings/registries replace Meteor services. NoLevitation keeps its existing levitation-only default; death record stores the latest position. These are implemented portions, not a claim of complete Meteor parity.
Original notices remain applicable. Local adaptation: WurstB+ Plus contributors.
